note: Alberta Parks provincial park in a forested valley at the Notikewin-Peace river confluence, 37 km N of Manning on Hwy 35, then 30 km E on Hwy 692. Treed drive-in sites; firewood sold. The lower loop and boat launch are currently closed due to a road failure (upper loop open). --Claude
